# Writing Executive Summaries

## Procedure
1. Identify the audience, decision and document stage. Read the current problem statement and primary report/results or protocol, not only another summary. Note review status and material unresolved issues.
2. Lead with the most decision-relevant supported conclusion. For proposals, lead with the problem and proposed study; never imply that planned analyses produced findings.
3. Present the problem and importance, research question/scope, brief method/evidence basis, key findings or planned outputs, limitations and recommended next action. Use plain language while retaining essential technical distinctions.
4. Trace every substantive claim and number to a source/result locator. Include meaningful units, population/sample context and uncertainty for material quantitative findings. No new analysis, unsupported ROI, novel causal claim or stronger conclusion than the underlying work.
5. Separate observed findings, interpretation and recommendation. State tradeoffs and constraints; if evidence is inconclusive, explain what decision remains supportable or which evidence is missing.
6. Default to roughly 250–500 words or one page unless instructed otherwise. Use three to five key findings only when the evidence supports them. Adapt format to the audience; an executive summary is not automatically a journal abstract.
7. Cross-check against the current source version and review log. Use `conducting-outsider-review` when comprehension is material; do not require a multi-agent review for a trivial summary.

## Deliver
Write `executive-summary.md` or the user's requested format with a discreet source-version/evidence pointer. State whether the underlying work is proposed, preliminary or completed and preserve material unresolved review findings.

## Boundaries
Condensation must not hide uncertainty or cherry-pick favorable results. Do not characterize internal AI review as external endorsement. For an unverified source, mark the limitation instead of laundering it through a polished summary.
